name: Collectible battlefield salvage
summary: Allows selected units to spawn value-carrying salvage on death and lets any crate-capable collector convert it into cash. The RA fixture reuses the stock supply-crate presentation and imports no upstream art.

sources.notes: Adapted into generic salvage traits without the upstream lobby-option dependency. Empty TerrainTypes now means all terrain, and 0 percent probability reliably disables spawning.

license.assets: No upstream assets imported; fixture uses the existing RA scrate sequences

integration.migration_notes: Concrete units opt in by inheriting ^ReusableSalvageable. Override probability, death types, terrain, and actor selection per faction. Replace REUSABLESALVAGE only when original faction-specific art is available.

evidence: Isolated Debug build of OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/OpenRA.Mods.Common completed with 0 errors.
OpenRA.Utility ra --check-yaml passed with the salvageable abstract actor and collectible salvage actor plus all bundled RA maps, sequences, and Fluent references.
